C : Type u
inst✝¹ : Category.{v, u} C
D : Type u_1
inst✝ : Category.{u_2, u_1} D
Z : D
F : C ⥤ D
M : (x : C) → Z ⟶ F.obj x
hM : ∀ (x y : C) (f : x ⟶ y), M x ≫ F.map f = M y
x : C
⊢ (match star, incl.obj x, Limits.IsInitial.to starInitial (incl.obj x) with
    | of x, of y, f => F.map (down f)
    | star, of x, x_1 => M x
    | star, star, x => 𝟙 Z) =
    M x
